name: Mitsubishi Paper Mills Limited
summary: Mitsubishi Paper Mills Limited provides functional products and paper materials in Japan, Europe, Asia, North America, and internationally. It operates through Functional Materials, Sustainable Fiber Materials, and Engineering segments. The company offers graphic arts materials comprising CTP/CTF; functional products, including air filters, total heat exchange cores, battery separators, wet-laid nonwovens, fireproof glass fiber products, ThermoRewrite, and membrane support substrates; and water treatment membrane substrates, construction materials, separators for power storage devices, electronics materials, rewritable media, photosensitive and printing plate-making materials, information so…
